description: Trigger routing for read-only single-axis audit dispatch (security / perf / simplify) on the active feature, vs sibling rite-* phases and bundled debug/review/interview/tdd/prototype/handoff skills.

queries.text: Can you run a security review on this feature before we polish it?
queries.rationale: "security review" is a verbatim security-axis trigger phrase.

queries.text: Is this change safe to ship? I'm worried about the auth path.
queries.rationale: "is this safe" plus an auth concern is the security axis.

queries.text: Check the diff for injection risks or any secrets that might be leaking.
queries.rationale: OWASP injection and secrets handling are the security auditor's discipline.

queries.text: Give the trust boundary on this feature an adversarial fresh-eyes read.
queries.rationale: Three-tier trust-boundary check via a no-author-context reviewer is the security axis.

queries.text: Is this fast enough to ship, or are we breaking the perf budget?
queries.rationale: "is this fast enough" plus a spec perf budget is the perf axis.

queries.text: Do a perf check on the active feature.
queries.rationale: "perf check" is a verbatim perf-axis trigger phrase.

queries.text: I think there's an N+1 query in here — can you audit it?
queries.rationale: "N+1" is a verbatim perf-axis trigger phrase.

queries.text: Are there any hot-path or payload-size problems in this slice?
queries.rationale: Hot-path work and payload size are measure-first perf reviewer concerns.

queries.text: Simplify this — it feels more complicated than it needs to be.
queries.rationale: "simplify this" is a verbatim simplify-axis trigger phrase.

queries.text: Is there a Chesterton's Fence here, or can we safely delete some of this code?
queries.rationale: "Chesterton's Fence" and the deletion test are the simplify axis.

queries.text: Get a fresh reviewer to flag behavior-preserving simplifications in the diff.
queries.rationale: Suggestion-only behavior-preserving simplification is exactly the simplify axis.

queries.text: Can this slice be cleaned up without changing behavior?
queries.rationale: Oblique but clear request for the behavior-preserving simplify audit.

queries.text: The build is red and the tests are throwing — debug why it's failing.
queries.rationale: Failing build/tests belong to diagnose (devrites-debug-recovery), not a read-only audit.

queries.text: Grill me on this plan until we've resolved every open branch of the design.
queries.rationale: Interviewing a plan belongs to grill-me / devrites-interview.

queries.text: Review my diff for correctness bugs and post the findings as inline PR comments.
queries.rationale: General correctness-bug diff review belongs to code-review, not a single-axis audit.

queries.text: Let's build this feature test-first with a red-green-refactor loop.
queries.rationale: Test-first red-green-refactor development belongs to tdd.

queries.text: Mock up a few radically different UI variations so I can play with them.
queries.rationale: Throwaway UI exploration belongs to prototype / rite-prototype.

queries.text: Compact this session into a handoff doc the next agent can pick up cold.
queries.rationale: Compacting context into a handoff belongs to handoff / rite-handoff.

queries.text: Implement the next vertical slice and write the code for it.
queries.rationale: Writing a slice is a write action owned by rite-build, not a read-only audit.

queries.text: Polish this feature to ship-quality and normalize the UI before review.
queries.rationale: Polishing and applying changes belongs to rite-polish, not a read-only audit.
